title: Course Weekend Roll on Lengthened Visit Referrals
content:
When an In-Group Specialist Referral, an HMO Specialist Referral, an Out-of-Network Referral or a Physical Therapy Episode Authorization (Referrals & Prior Authorizations) is lengthened, the course weekend roll follows the day on which the valid-through date, moved forward by the anchored span and the course re-check allowance added together (the course validity days counted before any course weekend roll), would fall: a Saturday gives a course weekend roll of 2 days and a Sunday a course weekend roll of 1 day, so the referral runs through the following Monday; any other day gives no course weekend roll. The course weekend roll is added to the course validity days.

## Dates worked through (hypothetical valid-through date of Tuesday 2026-06-30)

| Anchored span and allowance added together | Would fall on | Course weekend roll | Course validity days | Referral runs through |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 59 | Friday 2026-08-28 | none | 59 | Friday 2026-08-28 |
| 60 | Saturday 2026-08-29 | 2 days | 62 | Monday 2026-08-31 |
| 61 | Sunday 2026-08-30 | 1 day | 62 | Monday 2026-08-31 |
| 62 | Monday 2026-08-31 | none | 62 | Monday 2026-08-31 |
